verdicts.summary: All dated events confirmed on their pages (10 checked), but the two Algeciras events draw the wrong land: the Cliopatria 'Taifa of Algeciras' shapes they cite lie mostly or wholly in Málaga province, so Seville gains the Málaga hinterland in 1055, the Almoravids take land near Antequera in 1086, and the 1085 keyframe's correction subtracts a shape it does not touch (Algeciras stays Seville's to 1091). Mechanical to fix.

fixes.what: The region {cliopatria: Taifa of Algeciras, 1040} is about 72 percent Málaga province, not Algeciras: Coín and Vélez-Málaga are inside it, Málaga city 2 km off its coast edge, only 28 percent lies west of 5.25W.
fixes.why: Point and overlap tests on the Cliopatria geometry (grid feature cache). Seville's own 1056 keyframe (adjust, 'shape unchanged') does not hold that land: Coín is 53 km outside it, Vélez-Málaga 118 km. The Abbad II page names only 'Algeciras (1055)'. Málaga was a separate Hammudid taifa (the author's own counterparts list: taifa-of-malaga 1026-1057).
fixes.fix: Use {"place": "Algeciras", "km": 30, "country": "Spain", "text": "Algeciras and its district"} (or {"intersect": [{"cliopatria": "Taifa of Algeciras", "year": 1040}, {"admin1": "Cádiz", "country": "Spain"}]}); make the same change in taifa-of-algeciras /ledger/3 so both sides stay matched.

fixes.what: The region {cliopatria: Taifa of Algeciras, 1085} contains no Algeciras: that shape lies wholly in Málaga province (Antequera and Coín inside, Algeciras city 80 km outside, Tarifa 99 km).
fixes.why: Almoravid page: Algeciras was to 'be surrendered to him so he could use it as a base for his troops'; 'They did so in July 1086 without encountering resistance.' The page names Algeciras, the region draws the Antequera country.
fixes.fix: Use {"place": "Algeciras", "km": 30, "country": "Spain", "text": "Algeciras and its district"} (or {"intersect": [{"cliopatria": "Taifa of Algeciras", "year": 1040}, {"admin1": "Cádiz", "country": "Spain"}]}).

fixes.what: The correction {minus: [Seville 1085, Algeciras 1085]} removes nothing: the two Cliopatria shapes do not intersect (intersection area 0), while Algeciras city lies inside the Seville 1085 shape, so Algeciras stays drawn as Seville's from July 1086 to 1091.
fixes.why: Geometry test on the grid feature cache; same evidence as /ledger/17.
fixes.fix: {"minus": [{"cliopatria": "Taifa of Seville", "year": 1085}, {"place": "Algeciras", "km": 30, "country": "Spain"}], "text": "the 1085 shape without Algeciras, ceded to the Almoravids in July 1086; it holds 1078-1091"} (the after-1086 part could also be a new keyframe 1086-1091 with the 1078-1086 years left whole).

fixes.what: Minor, not blocking: the Seville page itself has 'Al-Mu'tamid seized Córdoba in 1071' and 'a brief interlude in 1075–1078'; the note quotes 1070 from the al-Mu'tamid and Toledo pages only.
fixes.fix: Add the 1071 variant to the note; keep 1070.

fixes.what: The note explains the 1066 shape as Zaragoza plus Tortosa only, but the shape also loses about 5,200 km2 against the 1046 shape (west edge from 3.29W to 2.12W; Medinaceli is inside the 1018-1046 shapes and outside from 1066); and it gives Tortosa 1056 as 7,334 km2 where shapes.csv has 6,768.
fixes.why: shapes.csv bboxes and a difference of the two Cliopatria geometries (1046 minus 1066 about 5,200 km2; 1066 minus 1046 about 7,200 km2, which is Tortosa).
fixes.fix: Acknowledge the western loss in the note and either add a dated loss (Castile or Toledo) or mark it 'unverified: page budget'; correct the area to 6,768 km2.

fixes.what: No event for Calahorra, which kingdom-of-pamplona /ledger/25 takes from taifa-of-zaragoza in 1045 (conf 2, 'Calahorra was wrested from the Moors') and which caliphate-of-cordoba /ledger/34 hands to Zaragoza in 1018; no Zaragoza shape contains Calahorra.
fixes.why: Point test: Calahorra (1.965W, 42.305N) is outside every Taifa of Zaragoza shape. Pamplona is not in the author's context list, so this is a routing gap rather than negligence.
fixes.fix: Either add Calahorra to the 1013-1045 keyframes (adjust) with a 1045 loss to kingdom-of-pamplona, or say in the notes that Calahorra was not Zaragoza's so the Pamplona and Caliphate owners can change their counterparts.
